messages:
jess: FYI: Packaging for private/vpc customer 'FinServCorp' scheduled for 2026-04-12 23:00 UTC. Need a compact checklist for the ops handoff and explicit rollback gates. Can we lock artifact pins by 17:00 PT? @omar
omar: Locking pins now. Running packager with `--shrinkwrap --oci-tree`. Will output to s3://redwood-artifacts/private/finserv/20260412/
signer-bot: signer-bot: created cosign signature for tarball, key-id=projects/finserv-prod/locations/global/keyF-02. Signature path: s3://redwood-artifacts/private/finserv/20260412/shrinkwrap.tar.gz.sig
pak: Quick question: are we doing mirror prefetch? Mirror ops prefer prefetch window 22:00-22:30 UTC same day. If yes we need manifest.fetch_timeout >= 10m and alt_url in manifest.
jess: Yes, prefetch agreed. Set fetch_timeout=15m and include alt_url. Also include `manifest.retry_policy=3` and `manifest.auth_method=ssh-key` in metadata.
omar: Upload complete. shrinkwrap.tar.gz (87MB), oci-repotree (compressed), manifest.json. SHA256 checksums in manifest.
deploybot: deploybot: canary job created for release=private-2026.04.12-finserv, channel=eng-releases
release-coordinator: Drafting rollback gates. Proposals: abort if canary shows >2x baseline error-rate OR >600ms p95 latency OR installer fails on >5% hosts during canary. If abort after 30% rollout, escalate to data rollback thread.
nina: Add a signer TTL requirement: signer-ttl >= 45m at canary start. Also ensure cosign key rotation window does not overlap packaging window.
tyler: Verified cosign sig on mirror (alt_url). Also confirmed mirror MD5 vs manifest sha256 mapping ok.
signer-bot: signer-bot: rotated signature due to manifest update. new signature id=finserv-20260412-v2.
omar: Note: We are pinning installer image to `redwood/private-installer@sha256:9a7f3b8d` in the shrinkwrap. I'll add that to release notes.
jess: Release notes snippet for customer ops:
- Window: 2026-04-12 23:00-01:00 UTC
- Artifacts: signed shrinkwrap + OCI repotree
- Mirrors: primary s3 + alt https mirror
- Rollback trigger: error-rate/latency/installer failure thresholds above
- Rollback command: `deploybot rollback private-2026.04.05`
- Contact: oncall + release-coordinator
Any changes?
pak: Add 'mirror prefetch step' and 'verify manifest.verify() on at least 2 mirrors' to checklist.
deplybot: deploybot: typo detected in previous line: 'deploybot' worked fine ;)
deploybot: deploybot: canary kickoff pending `manifest.verify()` success on two mirrors and signer-ttl >=45m
omar: Kicked off mirror prefetch at 22:05 UTC. Mirrors pulled artifact and validated sigs.
tyler: Canary started: 3 seed hosts in eu-west1. install logs: `installer: unpack -> dependencies ok -> service start`
jess: Monitoring hooks: set threshold alerts on p95_token_latency, api_error_rate, disk_io_wait. Dashboard: https://console/redwood/dashboards/canary/finserv
release-coordinator: If we hit rollback after 00:15 UTC we need cross-team approval for data migration rollback. Try to abort early otherwise longer outage.
nina: Confirming signer-ttl at 22:58 UTC is 58m. Good.
omar: Canary 30% started, metrics stable so far. No error spikes.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled scale -> 60% in 12m unless abort triggered
pak: Noted: packaging-bot re-uploaded manifest with alt_url timestamp fix at 22:50 UTC. Signature rotated.
jess: Thanks all. I'll publish release notes to customer ops and close thread in 1h if stable. :thumbsup:
